scanNote:
9-mashqda kitob javoblarni bermaydi — o'quvchi O'QITUVCHIDAN so'raydi. Bu yerda javoblar tarixiy faktlardan berildi; 1867 va 1934 yillari 70-betdagi rasm izohida ('Polish scientist 1867 - 1934') tasdiqlangan.

⚠⚠ KITOB XATOSI (imlo): matnda ism 'PIÈRRE Curie' deb yozilgan — 'e' ustida urg'u belgisi bilan. To'g'ri yozilishi — PIERRE, urg'usiz. Fransuz tilida ham, ingliz tilida ham bu ismda hech qanday urg'u belgisi yo'q. Kitob matni o'zgartirilmadi (asl holida qoldirildi), lekin o'quvchi to'g'ri shaklni bilishi kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Choose words from the list to fill in the gaps, then use them to make sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab bo'shliqlarni to'ldiring, so'ng ular bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: all over, worked, Princess, sick, car, in need,
        travel, fairy

Barcha iboralar 71-betdagi Diana haqidagi maqoladan olingan.

QANDAY TANLANADI:
  bo'shliqdan KEYIN ot bo'lsa → SIFAT yoki aniqlovchi kerak
     ...... accident → car
  bo'shliqdan OLDIN ot bo'lsa → izohlovchi ibora kerak
     those ...... → in need

items.whyUz:
'she WORKED as a nanny' = enaga bo'lib ishladi.
71-betdagi 1-xatboshidan.
'work AS' — 'as' shart.

'ALL OVER the world' = butun dunyo bo'ylab.
71-betda: 'sick and poor people ALL OVER the world'.

'a FAIRY tale' = ertak.
71-betdagi maqola nomi: 'A Fairy-Tale Princess'.
'a fairy' = pari.

'TRAVEL round the world' = dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilmoq.
71-betda: 'continued to TRAVEL round the world'.
'round' = 'around' bilan bir xil.

'SICK people' = kasal odamlar.
71-betda: 'she cared about SICK and poor people'.
'sick' = 'ill' bilan bir xil.

'the PRINCESS of Wales' = Uels malikasi.
Bosh harf bilan — unvon.
'the' SHART (yagona unvon).

'those IN NEED' = muhtojlar.
71-betda: 'help those IN NEED'.
'need' = ehtiyoj.

'a CAR accident' = avtohalokat.
71-betda: 'she died in a CAR accident'.
70-betdagi 3-mashqda 'train accident' XATO edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Then use them to make sentences.
exercises.explanationUz:
Gaplarni 71-betdagi maqoladan olsangiz eng yaxshi bo'ladi —
hammasi o'sha yerda bor.

items.answer: When she returned to England she worked as a nanny in London.
items.whyUz: 'work AS a nanny' = enaga bo'lib ishlamoq.

items.answer: She cared about sick and poor people all over the world.
items.whyUz: 'all over the world' — o'zgarmas ibora.

items.answer: It was like a fairy tale when she married the Prince.
items.whyUz: 'like a fairy tale' = ertakdek.

items.answer: Diana continued to travel round the world.
items.whyUz: 'continue TO travel' qolipi.

items.answer: She helped sick people in many countries.
items.whyUz: 'sick' sifat sifatida otdan OLDIN turadi.

items.answer: Diana became the Princess of Wales in 1981.
items.whyUz:
'become' → 'became' (noto'g'ri fe'l).
'the Princess of Wales' — 'the' shart.
'those in need' = muhtojlar (ot vazifasida).

items.answer: She died in a car accident in Paris.
items.whyUz: 'die IN an accident' — predlog IN.

exercises.instructionEn: Dates — how we write and say them.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

  YOZAMIZ:  26/8/1959   yoki   26th August, 1959

  AYTAMIZ:  the twenty-sixth of August, nineteen fifty-nine
            YOKI
            August the twenty-sixth, nineteen fifty-nine

IKKI XIL AYTISH USULI:

  1-USUL:  THE + tartib son + OF + oy + yil
           the twenty-sixth of August, nineteen fifty-nine

  2-USUL:  oy + THE + tartib son + yil
           August the twenty-sixth, nineteen fifty-nine

  Ikkalasi ham TO'G'RI — farqi yo'q.

DIQQAT — KUN DOIM TARTIB SON:
  1st  = the first        2nd  = the second
  3rd  = the third        4th  = the fourth
  5th  = the fifth        8th  = the eighth
  13th = the thirteenth   16th = the sixteenth
  21st = the twenty-first 25th = the twenty-fifth
  29th = the twenty-ninth 31st = the thirty-first

DIQQAT — YIL QANDAY O'QILADI:
  Yil IKKI JUFTGA bo'linadi:
     1959 → 19 | 59 → nineteen fifty-nine
     1935 → 19 | 35 → nineteen thirty-five
     1825 → 18 | 25 → eighteen twenty-five
     1899 → 18 | 99 → eighteen ninety-nine

  ISTISNO — oxiri '00' bo'lsa:
     1900 → nineteen hundred
     1980 → nineteen eighty  ('nineteen eight-oh' EMAS)
     2000 → two thousand
     2010 → two thousand and ten / twenty ten

DIQQAT — BRITAN va AMERIKA YOZILISHI FARQ QILADI:
  Britancha:  26/8/1959  (kun/oy/yil)
  Amerikacha: 8/26/1959  (oy/kun/yil)
  Chalkashmaslik uchun oy nomini YOZISH yaxshiroq.

⚠⚠ KITOB XATOSI (imlo) — 'PIÈRRE':

  Kitobda ism 'PIÈRRE Curie' deb yozilgan
  — 'e' ustida urg'u belgisi bilan.

  ⚠ To'g'ri yozilishi — PIERRE, URG'USIZ.
  Fransuz tilida ham, ingliz tilida ham bu
  ismda urg'u belgisi YO'Q.

  ⚠ Xuddi shu xato 73-betda ham bor:
  'Pièrre-Auguste Renoir'.

  ⚠ Ammo 12-betda kitob shu ismni TO'G'RI
  yozgan — 'Pierre'. Demak bu nashriyot
  xatosi, ataylab emas.

points.noteUz:
Raqam bilan yoki oy nomi bilan.
Britanchada kun BIRINCHI turadi.

points.en: We say: the twenty-sixth of August, nineteen fifty-nine
points.uz: Aytamiz: avgustning yigirma oltinchisi, ming to'qqiz yuz ellik to'qqiz
points.noteUz:
1-USUL: THE + tartib son + OF + oy.
'of' SHART.

points.en: or August the twenty-sixth, nineteen fifty-nine
points.uz: yoki avgust yigirma oltinchi, ming to'qqiz yuz ellik to'qqiz
points.noteUz:
2-USUL: oy + THE + tartib son.
'of' YO'Q, lekin 'the' BOR.

points.en: Time expressions: yesterday, ago, in 1950, last Monday/week/month
points.noteUz:
Bular O'TGAN ZAMON belgilari —
ko'rsangiz, past simple ishlatiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the dates and say them in the two ways shown above, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Sanalarga qarang va ularni yuqoridagi ikki usulda ayting, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
UCH ODAM:
  Elvis Presley     8th January, 1935 - 16th August, 1977
  Alfred Hitchcock  13th August, 1899 - 29th April, 1980
  Johann Strauss    25th October, 1825 - 3rd June, 1899

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA (ikki usul):
  Elvis Presley was born on the eighth of January,
  nineteen thirty-five and died ...
  Elvis Presley was born on January the eighth,
  nineteen thirty-five and died ...

QOLIP:
  [ism] was born ON [sana] and died ON [sana].

DIQQAT — 'ON' HAR IKKI SANA OLDIDA:
  was born ON ... and died ON ...

KIMLAR BU ODAMLAR:
  ELVIS PRESLEY    — amerikalik qo'shiqchi, 'rok-n-rol qiroli'
                     (70-betdagi 1-mashqda ham bor)
  ALFRED HITCHCOCK — britaniyalik kinorejissor,
                     triller filmlari ustasi
  JOHANN STRAUSS   — avstriyalik bastakor, 'vals qiroli'

items.answer: Elvis Presley was born on the eighth of January, nineteen thirty-five and died on the sixteenth of August, nineteen seventy-seven.
items.whyUz:
1-USUL: the + tartib son + OF + oy.
1935 → nineteen thirty-five;  1977 → nineteen seventy-seven.

items.answer: Elvis Presley was born on January the eighth, nineteen thirty-five and died on August the sixteenth, nineteen seventy-seven.
items.whyUz:
2-USUL: oy + THE + tartib son.
'of' YO'Q.

items.answer: Alfred Hitchcock was born on the thirteenth of August, eighteen ninety-nine and died on the twenty-ninth of April, nineteen eighty.
items.whyUz:
1899 → eighteen ninety-nine.
1980 → NINETEEN EIGHTY (oxiri '80' — 'eighty' deyiladi,
'eight-oh' EMAS).

items.answer: Alfred Hitchcock was born on August the thirteenth, eighteen ninety-nine and died on April the twenty-ninth, nineteen eighty.
items.whyUz: 2-USUL: August the thirteenth / April the twenty-ninth.

items.answer: Johann Strauss was born on the twenty-fifth of October, eighteen twenty-five and died on the third of June, eighteen ninety-nine.
items.whyUz:
'3rd' = the THIRD (the 'threeth' EMAS).
1825 → eighteen twenty-five;  1899 → eighteen ninety-nine.

items.answer: Johann Strauss was born on October the twenty-fifth, eighteen twenty-five and died on June the third, eighteen ninety-nine.
items.whyUz:
2-USUL: October the twenty-fifth / June the third.
DIQQAT: Hitchcock tug'ilgan yil (1899) Strauss vafot etgan
yil bilan bir xil.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the table, then say how we form the past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Jadvalga qarang, so'ng oddiy o'tgan zamon qanday yasalishini ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST SIMPLE FORM (jadval):

  TASDIQ       I/you/he, etc  WATCHED TV last night.
  INKOR        I/you/he, etc  DIDN'T WATCH TV last night.
  SO'ROQ       DID I/you/he, etc  WATCH TV last night?
  QISQA JAVOB  Yes, I/you/he, etc DID.
               No,  I/you/he, etc DIDN'T.

QANDAY YASALADI:

  TASDIQ:  fe'l + -ED  (yoki noto'g'ri fe'l shakli)
           watch → watched;  make → made
           HAMMA EGA UCHUN BIR XIL — -s YO'Q!

  INKOR:   DIDN'T + fe'lning ASOSIY shakli
           I didn't WATCH   ✓
           I didn't WATCHED ✗ XATO

  SO'ROQ:  DID + ega + fe'lning ASOSIY shakli
           Did you WATCH?   ✓
           Did you WATCHED? ✗ XATO

  QISQA JAVOB: did / didn't (asosiy fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI)
           Yes, I did.      ✓
           Yes, I watched.  ✗

ENG MUHIM QOIDA:
  'DID' yoki 'DIDN'T' bor bo'lsa — fe'l ASOSIY shaklda.
  Sababi: 'did' allaqachon o'tgan zamonni ko'rsatgan.
  Bu — 9-unitdagi 'didn't have' qoidasining o'zi.

USE (ishlatilishi):
  Past simple ni O'TMISHDA sodir bo'lgan va QAYTA
  TAKRORLANMAYDIGAN harakatlar uchun ishlatamiz.
     Diana MARRIED Prince Charles in July, 1981.
     (When did she marry him? In July, 1981.)

  VAQT IBORALARI (past simple belgilari):
     yesterday       = kecha
     ... ago         = ...oldin
     in 1950         = 1950-yilda
     last Monday     = o'tgan dushanba
     last week/month = o'tgan hafta/oy

WAS/WERE BILAN SOLISHTIRING (9-unit):
  'to be'  → did KERAK EMAS:  Were you at home?
  boshqa fe'l → did KERAK:    Did you watch TV?
exercises.bookRef: Coursebook, 72-bet, Past Simple jadvali va Use qutisi

points.en: I/you/he, etc watched TV last night.
points.uz: Men / sen / u kecha kechqurun televizor ko'rdim(ding)(di).
points.noteUz:
TASDIQ: fe'l + -ED.
Hamma ega uchun BIR XIL — 'he watcheds' XATO.

points.en: I/you/he, etc didn't watch TV last night.
points.noteUz:
INKOR: DIDN'T + ASOSIY shakl.
'didn't watched' XATO.

points.en: Did I/you/he, etc watch TV last night?
points.noteUz:
SO'ROQ: DID + ega + ASOSIY shakl.
'Did you watched?' XATO.

points.en: Yes, I/you/he, etc did. — No, I/you/he, etc didn't.
points.noteUz:
Qisqa javobda faqat 'did/didn't' —
asosiy fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI.

points.en: We use the past simple for actions which happened in the past and won't happen again.
points.uz: Past simple ni o'tmishda sodir bo'lgan va qayta takrorlanmaydigan harakatlar uchun ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI QOIDA.
'won't happen again' = qayta sodir bo'lmaydi.

points.en: Diana married Prince Charles in July, 1981.
points.uz: Diana 1981-yil iyulda shahzoda Charlzga turmushga chiqdi.
points.noteUz:
KITOBDAGI MISOL.
Aniq vaqt ko'rsatilgan, voqea tugagan.

points.en: Time expressions: yesterday, ago, in 1950, last Monday/week/month, etc.
points.uz: Vaqt iboralari: kecha, ...oldin, 1950-yilda, o'tgan dushanba/hafta/oy va h.k.
points.noteUz:
Bu so'zlarni ko'rsangiz — PAST SIMPLE ishlating.
'ago' DOIM gap oxirida: two years AGO.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the text, then ask your teacher the following questions to complete the text.
exercises.instructionUz: Matnni o'qing, so'ng matnni to'ldirish uchun o'qituvchingizga quyidagi savollarni bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
MASHQNING MAQSADI:
  Kitob javoblarni BERMAYDI — siz SAVOL berib bilib olasiz.
  Bu — so'roq gap tuzishni mashq qilish uchun.

OLTI SAVOL:
  1  When was she born?          → 1) bo'shliq
  2  Where was she born?         → 2) bo'shliq
  3  When did she marry Pièrre Curie?  → 3) bo'shliq
  4  What did they discover?     → 4) bo'shliq
  5  When did Pièrre die?        → 5) bo'shliq
  6  When did she die?           → 6) bo'shliq

SAVOL QOLIPLARI:
  'to be' bilan  → When/Where WAS she born?  ('did' YO'Q)
  boshqa fe'l    → When DID she MARRY? ('did' + asosiy shakl)

TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Marie Sklodowska (Marie Curie) was a famous scientist.
  She was born in 1867 in Warsaw, Poland. She studied
  physics and mathematics at the Sorbonne in Paris. She
  married Pièrre Curie in 1895. Together they discovered
  polonium and radium in 1898. In 1903, the Curies received
  the Nobel Prize for Physics. Pièrre died in a road
  accident in 1906. Marie continued their work on radium.
  In 1911, she received the Nobel Prize for Chemistry.
  She died of leukaemia in 1934.

O'ZBEKCHA TARJIMASI:
  Mariya Sklodovska (Mari Kyuri) mashhur olima edi.
  U 1867-yilda Polshaning Varshava shahrida tug'ilgan.
  U Parijdagi Sorbonnada fizika va matematika o'qidi.
  1895-yilda Pyer Kyuriga turmushga chiqdi. Ular birgalikda
  1898-yilda poloniy va radiyni kashf etishdi. 1903-yilda
  Kyurilar fizika bo'yicha Nobel mukofotini olishdi.
  Pyer 1906-yilda yo'l-transport hodisasida halok bo'ldi.
  Mariya radiy ustidagi ishlarini davom ettirdi. 1911-yilda
  u kimyo bo'yicha Nobel mukofotini oldi. U 1934-yilda
  leykemiyadan vafot etdi.

JAVOBLAR QAYERDAN OLINDI:
  1867 va 1934 — 70-betdagi rasm izohida yozilgan
                 ('Polish scientist 1867 - 1934').
  Qolgan yillar — tarixiy faktlar.
  Kitobning o'zida bu javoblar YO'Q — o'qituvchi aytadi.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  physics      = fizika
  mathematics  = matematika
  to discover  = kashf etmoq
  to receive   = olmoq
  the Nobel Prize = Nobel mukofoti
  chemistry    = kimyo
  a road accident = yo'l-transport hodisasi
  leukaemia    = leykemiya (qon saratoni)
  radium       = radiy
  polonium     = poloniy (Polsha nomidan)

items.textEn: 1  She was born in ............ .   (savol: When was she born?)
items.whyUz:
70-betdagi B-rasm izohi: 'Polish scientist (1867 - 1934)'.
SAVOL QOLIPI: 'When WAS she BORN?' — 'be born' majhul nisbat,
shuning uchun 'did' KERAK EMAS.

items.textEn: 2  She was born in 1867 in ............ .   (savol: Where was she born?)
items.whyUz:
Mariya Sklodovska Varshavada tug'ilgan.
70-betda 'POLISH scientist' deyilgan — polshalik.
SAVOL QOLIPI: 'Where WAS she BORN?'

items.textEn: 3  She married Pièrre Curie in ............ .   (savol: When did she marry Pièrre Curie?)
items.whyUz:
Mariya va Pyer 1895-yilda turmush qurishgan.
SAVOL QOLIPI: 'When DID she MARRY ...?' —
oddiy fe'l, shuning uchun 'did' + ASOSIY shakl ('marry').

items.textEn: 4  Together they discovered ............ and ............ in 1898.   (savol: What did they discover?)
items.whyUz:
Kyurilar 1898-yilda POLONIY va RADIYni kashf etishgan.
'polonium' nomi POLSHA (Poland) nomidan olingan —
Mariya vatanini sharaflagan.
Matnning oxirida 'their work on RADIUM' deyilgan —
bu javobni tasdiqlaydi.
SAVOL QOLIPI: 'What DID they DISCOVER?'

items.textEn: 5  Pièrre died in a road accident in ............ .   (savol: When did Pièrre die?)
items.whyUz:
Pyer Kyuri 1906-yilda Parijda yo'l-transport hodisasida
halok bo'lgan.
SAVOL QOLIPI: 'When DID Pièrre DIE?' — 'did' + 'die'
(asosiy shakl, 'died' EMAS).

items.textEn: 6  She died of leukaemia in ............ .   (savol: When did she die?)
items.whyUz:
70-betdagi B-rasm izohi: '(1867 - 1934)'.
DIQQAT — PREDLOG:
  'die OF an illness' = kasallikdan vafot etmoq
  'die IN an accident' = halokatda halok bo'lmoq
5-band bilan solishtiring: Pyer IN a road accident,
Mariya OF leukaemia.

exercises.instructionEn: Write down two things you did yesterday and two things you didn't do yesterday. Choose from the list. You can use your own ideas.
exercises.instructionUz: Kecha qilgan ikkita ishingizni va qilmagan ikkita ishingizni yozing. Ro'yxatdan tanlang. O'z fikringizdan ham foydalanishingiz mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (10 ta ish):
  study, make a cake, play football, cut the grass,
  watch TV, cook dinner, listen to music, do the shopping,
  go for a walk, buy clothes

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  I made a cake yesterday but I didn't cook dinner.

QOLIP:
  I [o'tgan zamon fe'li] yesterday BUT I DIDN'T [asosiy fe'l].

ENG MUHIM DIQQAT — IKKI XIL SHAKL BIR GAPDA:
  I MADE a cake        (tasdiq → o'tgan shakl)
  I DIDN'T COOK dinner (inkor → ASOSIY shakl)

  'I didn't cooked' XATO!

RO'YXATDAGI FE'LLARNING O'TGAN SHAKLI:

  TO'G'RI FE'LLAR (-ed):
     study        → studied      (Y → I + ED)
     play         → played
     watch        → watched
     cook         → cooked
     listen       → listened

  NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR (yodlash kerak):
     make         → MADE
     cut          → CUT          (O'ZGARMAYDI!)
     do           → DID
     go           → WENT
     buy          → BOUGHT

DIQQAT — 'CUT':
  'cut' o'tgan zamonda ham 'cut' bo'lib qoladi.
  I cut the grass yesterday.  (o'tgan zamon)
  Shunga o'xshash: put → put, let → let, hit → hit.

structure.heading: 1  make a cake / cook dinner
structure.guideUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
'make' → MADE (noto'g'ri fe'l).
Inkorda 'didn't COOK' (asosiy shakl).
structure.modelEn: I made a cake yesterday but I didn't cook dinner.

structure.heading: 2  watch TV / study
structure.modelEn: I watched TV yesterday but I didn't study.

structure.heading: 3  go for a walk / play football
structure.modelEn: I went for a walk yesterday but I didn't play football.

structure.heading: 4  listen to music / buy clothes
structure.modelEn: I listened to music yesterday but I didn't buy clothes.

structure.heading: 5  do the shopping / cut the grass
structure.modelEn: I did the shopping yesterday but I didn't cut the grass.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing prepositions from the list below.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi ro'yxatdan tushib qolgan predloglarni qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: with, in, on, to, at, round, of

7 ta predlog, 13 ta bo'shliq — demak ba'zilari
BIR NECHA MARTA ishlatiladi:
  in  → 5 marta
  at  → 2 marta
  on  → 2 marta
  qolganlari → 1 martadan

Hamma ibora 71-betdagi Diana haqidagi maqoladan olingan.

SANA va JOY PREDLOGLARI — QISQA QOIDA:
  ON + aniq sana yoki kun    → on 1st July;  on Monday
  IN + oy, yil, shahar, mamlakat → in July;  in 1961;
                                    in Norfolk
  AT + aniq bino yoki nuqta  → at a school;
                               at St Paul's Cathedral

items.whyUz:
Aniq sana (kun + oy + yil) → ON.
'on 1st July, 1961'.

Shahar va mamlakat → IN.
'in Norfolk, England'.

Kun ko'rsatilmagan, faqat oy va yil → IN.
1-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda kun bor edi → ON.

'study AT a school' — maktab va universitet bilan AT.
'at the Sorbonne' (9-mashqda) ham shunday.

'return TO a place' = biror joyga qaytmoq.
Harakat YO'NALISHI → TO.

Aniq bino → AT.
'at St Paul's Cathedral'.

Shahar → IN.
Bir gapda ikkalasi: AT bino, IN shahar.

'ON television' = televizorda.
Shunga o'xshash: on the radio, on the phone,
on the Internet.

'have problems WITH something' = ...da muammo bo'lmoq.
71-betda: 'They had problems WITH their marriage'.

'travel ROUND the world' = dunyo bo'ylab sayohat qilmoq.
'round' = 'around' bilan bir xil (britanchada 'round' ko'proq).

'those IN need' = muhtojlar — o'zgarmas ibora.
6-mashqning 7-bandida ham bor.
'die IN an accident' = halokatda halok bo'lmoq.

'die OF an illness' = kasallikdan vafot etmoq.
10-band bilan SOLISHTIRING — bu eng muhim juftlik:
  die IN an accident  (halokat)
  die OF an illness   (kasallik)
9-mashqdagi Mari Kyuri 'died OF leukaemia' edi.

wordFormation.introUz: 72-bet — past simple, noto'g'ri fe'llar, sana o'qish, predloglar.

items.base: Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.

groups.explanationUz: Kun DOIM tartib son bilan aytiladi.

groups.ruleUz: DIE bilan predloglar — eng muhim juftlik

patterns.formula: Ega + fe'l+ED (yoki noto'g'ri shakl) + ... + vaqt iborasi.
patterns.exampleEn: I watched TV last night. Diana married Prince Charles in July, 1981.
patterns.exampleUz: Kecha kechqurun televizor ko'rdim. Diana 1981-yil iyulda shahzoda Charlzga turmushga chiqdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Tasdiq gapda fe'l O'TGAN shaklda.
Hamma ega uchun bir xil — -s yo'q.

patterns.formula: Ega + DIDN'T + ASOSIY fe'l.   /   DID + ega + ASOSIY fe'l?
patterns.exampleEn: I didn't cook dinner. Did you watch TV last night?
patterns.exampleUz: Kechki ovqat pishirmadim. Kecha kechqurun televizor ko'rdingmi?
patterns.explanationUz:
'did/didn't' bor bo'lsa — fe'l ASOSIY shaklda.
Eng ko'p uchraydigan xato: 'didn't watched'.

patterns.formula: I + o'tgan fe'l + yesterday BUT I didn't + asosiy fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: I made a cake yesterday but I didn't cook dinner.
patterns.exampleUz: Kecha tort pishirdim, lekin kechki ovqat pishirmadim.
patterns.explanationUz: Bitta gapda IKKI xil shakl: 'made' (tasdiq) va 'cook' (inkor).

patterns.formula: X was born ON the [tartib son] OF [oy], [yil] and died ON ... .
patterns.exampleEn: Elvis Presley was born on the eighth of January, nineteen thirty-five and died on the sixteenth of August, nineteen seventy-seven.
patterns.exampleUz: Elvis Presli 1935-yil 8-yanvarda tug'ilgan va 1977-yil 16-avgustda vafot etgan.

patterns.formula: X was born ON [oy] THE [tartib son], [yil].
patterns.exampleEn: Elvis Presley was born on January the eighth, nineteen thirty-five.

patterns.formula: WHEN/WHERE WAS he/she BORN?   ↔   WHEN DID he/she DIE?
patterns.exampleEn: When was she born? — In 1867. When did she die? — In 1934.
patterns.exampleUz: U qachon tug'ilgan? — 1867-yilda. Qachon vafot etgan? — 1934-yilda.
patterns.explanationUz:
'be born' — 'did' KERAK EMAS ('to be' bilan).
'die' — 'did' KERAK (oddiy fe'l).

patterns.formula: die IN an accident   ↔   die OF an illness.
patterns.exampleEn: Pièrre died in a road accident. She died of leukaemia.
patterns.exampleUz: Pyer yo'l-transport hodisasida halok bo'ldi. U leykemiyadan vafot etdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Halokat → IN;  kasallik → OF.
Bu farqni yodlab qo'yish kerak.
